action_summary: Deletes the world model from planning. On a real clone of pypa/packaging, 6 real damaged states and 10 real git actions, the planner copies the state, runs the action and reads the exit status: one execution yields both applicability and the exact successor, so the search runs over real directories and predicts nothing (transitions_predicted = 0). Pruning on learned conditions solves 6 of 7 in 658 executions (318 edges deleted); the no-knowledge control solves 7 of 7 in 1315; using the same knowledge only to ORDER solves 7 of 7 in 1337. Pruning buys 50% and loses one task in seven, and the conditions pruned on are named 0 of 10. Three goals were falsified by plans: cleanliness is met by dropping the stash (destroying the work), identity with the starting commit plus preserve is unsatisfiable (204 executions, 0 solved), and the content goal was met by committing the mess onto the branch it was on until every other branch tip was pinned. The remaining designed part is the dedup KEY: coarse key 0 of 3 hard tasks at 1500 expansions; keyed on what git reports, solved at depth 5, 6, 6. 0 parameters, 0 model calls, 0 transitions predicted.

truth.the_law_this_round_adds: EXACTNESS IS FREE, COMPLETENESS IS NOT. Copying a state and running the action makes the successor exact at the price of one execution and deletes the world model entirely (0 transitions predicted). What remains expensive is branching, and what remains unsound is any prior strong enough to cut it: the conditions that deleted 318 edges were named 0 of 10 times and lost one task in seven. A prior that only orders is safe and was worth 0 here. What is left to design is a key as fine as the goal, and a goal that cannot be satisfied by throwing away what the owner cares about.
